items.back: Weekend closure. A previously available exit is shut by an authority's rule on a class, timed to the hours when no one can act on it, because any notice of the closure would itself start the run it is meant to prevent. The Greek banks that did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address; the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013, extended after parliament rejected the first levy until the bail-in was law; the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001; the export licence suspended, the delisting published after the fact. Condition lost: a permission, the leave to move what is yours. Carrier: the authority's calendar, aligned to the hours the holder is locked out (Friday night, bank holiday, Sunday decree). Last intervention: a transfer made on rumour, carrying the full cost of being wrong and the discount the rumour market charges; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better. Tell: this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it; a holder waiting for a date is waiting for something the mechanism forbids to exist. Changed next move: act on the rumour or not at all; no date will come. Adds to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and unreachable: this is the mechanism that chose the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can probe by letting it pass, since a closure that can be probed need not be a surprise; not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which someone at the holder's own table decides, since the decree is an authority's rule on a class and no one at the table decided about the holder. The item rests on that boundary and not on any claim that the exit dies as a side effect: the decree forbids the exit by name.

Bar date in the newspaper. The standing to be paid or to sue on one's own is cut off on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder was not party to, and the holder is deemed to have read it. The bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to creditors the debtor could not name by publication in a newspaper; the class settlement whose opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like advertising; the probate creditor's window that opens and closes after the notice runs in the county paper. Condition lost: a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue individually. Carrier: the bar-date order together with the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as the holder's knowledge precisely because no one could name them. Last intervention: a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the least often made, because the person who would make it is by construction the one who was not told. Tell: the date exists and is readable, but on someone else's docket; not having been told is no defence. Changed next move: read the legal notices in any forum where one might be an unnamed creditor or class member, and file the one page. Adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission with a date readable on the stamp: here the date is written on another party's docket and imputed to the holder. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness, since nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

Emergency over. A permission carved out of a parent instrument ends when the parent's term ends, whatever the grant's own merits, and the grant itself carries no date. The emergency-use authorization that ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing; the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022; the wartime power; the pilot programme run under a waiver; the sub-lease that dies with the head lease. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant the holder did read carried no date; the first task is to find which parent paper carries the date. Last intervention: conversion (a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in the holder's own name) filed while the parent still stands; conversion is slow enough that it must begin while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when no one wants to begin it. Tell: a grant with no expiry printed on it that was issued 'under' something else. Changed next move: identify the parent instrument and its term, then start conversion while the temporary grant is still in force. Not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed, since here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest; not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

Patch before seven. A capability closes on a developmental timetable the holder cannot read, so the last intervention is necessarily in another party's hand. Amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and responds less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens; the clubfoot cast in infancy; the second language spoken without an accent, contested as a hard window; the duckling that imprints in its first day. Condition lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable; the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save. Last intervention: screening (the preschool vision check, the parent who notices a squint), so the option belongs to one person and its keeping to another; where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child. Tell: the holder cannot be its own witness; the keeping is done on the holder's behalf or not at all. Changed next move: build or use the screening programme; the child will never raise it. Adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option: this is the case in which the holder cannot witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it, since nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

Last known well. A treatment the body might still permit is refused because the protocol dates the option by the last witness to onset rather than by the tissue, so it expires when the proof runs out while the body might still allow it. The stroke patient who wakes with the deficit is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke loses the drug regardless of when the artery closed; the same rule dates the opened vial with no time written on the label and the sample whose chain of custody has a gap, each treated as expired at the earliest time it could have been. Condition lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue. Last intervention: a witness (someone awake, a time written on the vial) or a witness of a different kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset. Tell: the thing is physically still on the table and is denied on a proof. Changed next move: attack the proof, not the physiology: write the time on the vial, get the imaging. Adds to witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form: the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run, since here the body's clock may not have run and the record's has.

Mooted. A ruling is never given because the harm ended before the forum reached it; no one had to refuse and no one ruled. The student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974); the pregnancy over before the appeal; the election held before the ballot-access case; the tenant evicted before the housing court sits; the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. Condition lost: a permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number set by no one at the holder's table. Last intervention: a structure that outlives the individual harm: the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, on which Roe rested. Tell: there is no date anywhere; the harm simply ends first. Changed next move: the option is kept by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying; build the claim larger than one plaintiff before that plaintiff's harm ends. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten on a curve, since here nothing is eaten and the harm is simply over; not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date.

Session ends. The body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter still pending, and its successor starts the matter at zero without ever saying no. The bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning; the treaty signed and waiting on a parliament that is dissolved; the permit application before a council that is re-elected; the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting; the offer approved by a committee that the reorganization disbanded. What expires is the matter's place in the process. Condition lost: a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar: election, session, or term. Last intervention: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway. The treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone; the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no. Tell: an informal yes from a body that has a term. Changed next move: get the minute, not the nod; the nod dies with the body that gave it. Adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain: here the ratifier wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes. A promise made by a person rather than written on the paper that transfers dies at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see. The renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises; the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves; the side letter with a fund's partner that the fund's successor manager has never seen; the supplier's verbal priority that vanishes with the account executive. Condition lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register (the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead) on which the option was never written, so the successor takes free of it. Last intervention: recording: a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors, at the cost of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement. Tell: the promise lives in a person, not on the instrument that transfers. Changed next move: accept the awkwardness and record it. Adds to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have: the mirror case, where the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over. A return to a seat is lost when the vacancy is absorbed at the counterparty's next planning cycle, with no one declining the return. The leave taken with no return date whose post is redistributed among three people at the next reorganization; the budget line reallocated at year end; the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed; the co-founder's seat that the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire. What expires is the return to the seat; employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from the outside. Condition lost: a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence (quarterly, annual, the next reorganization), which sets the expiry without reference to the holder at all. Last intervention: a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. Tell: an open-ended absence against a counterparty that has a planning cycle. Changed next move: put a date on the return; an intention to return is not a reservation, only a date is. Adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents: here no one opposes the return and the absence is simply absorbed. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way, since this road has closed.

Petition that goes stale. An option that requires simultaneous assent expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of every assent; a coordination has a half-life. The recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days; the tender offer's minimum condition that must be met by the offer's expiry; the crowd in the square that goes home; the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time. Condition lost: a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention. Last intervention: a gathering rate (paid circulators), a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives. The recall and tender cases are observed; the crowd is analogy. Tell: many small clocks, each started by an assent, none of them the holder's. Changed next move: collect at a rate that beats the decay, or bind the early assents; collecting one at a time is how the first ones spoil. Adds to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving: here the coordination is lost by others' leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter, since here many small calendars do.

Outgrown the buyer. The option to sell to the natural acquirer expires at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all: a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with no one at either table declining. The company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done; the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two; the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed. Condition lost: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, set against the holder's own price, which each round raises. Last intervention: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, never recognized as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make. This is analytical, since every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so the item stands as a mechanism and not a count. Tell: the holder's own growth is what removes the counterparty; the price driven up is the price no one can pay. Changed next move: read the buyers' capacity before pricing the round, and treat the ceiling as a deadline. Adds to market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside: here the holder thins its own market by growing. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans, since here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has left its range.

Pour the foundation. A permission about to be taken by a third party's rule change can be kept only by an act in the world; no paper will keep it. The building that may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun in reliance on a valid permit before the ordinance passes; the footings poured the week of the council vote; the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if it is in use on the effective date; the grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application; the last act differs by jurisdiction, and the holder who knows which has a different week. Last intervention: the hole in the ground before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made; the option is preserved only by starting to use it. Tell: a pending rule change and a doctrine that counts acts, not applications. Changed next move: learn the jurisdiction's vesting trigger and perform it before the vote; nothing short of the pour counts. Adds to first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose: here the rule changes for reasons of its own. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right, since here one beginning vests it for good.

Slot flown empty. A permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the keeping act is the exercise emptied of everything it was for. The airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived; the water right under prior appropriation forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them; the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use; the mining claim kept by annual labour; the department budget spent in the last quarter so that it is not cut. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Last intervention: the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using become the same act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price. Tell: a usage threshold in the rule, and a holder embarrassed by the empty seats. Changed next move: budget the upkeep as exercise, repeatedly, or plan to lose the permission. Adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and whose clock no cash extends: here is the price at which it can be extended after all, the hours flown for nobody. Adds to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp: the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it. Adds to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved: here disuse forfeits it by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests, since here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Thawed to be ready. Readiness starts a decay the unready state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready. The vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured; the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing; the drawn dose; the armed fuze; the reagent brought to room temperature; the opened surgical field; the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. Condition lost: a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry, or a season, that begins at preparation. Last intervention: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit: the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings. The clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought readiness with the doses it will discard at closing. Tell: the shelf life changes at preparation; the price of readiness is paid in the good itself. Changed next move: size the prepared unit to the booked demand. Mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched, since here it dies of being touched; a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed; not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day, since here it falls on the good.

First or never. An objection is kept only by taking it before any other move on a linked matter; its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date. Do nothing and it is kept; do anything adjacent and it is lost. The objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant that is waived if left out of the first response; the patent that is dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States; the appeal waived by accepting the settlement; the election of remedies; the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used; the 'speak now' at the wedding. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, and the sequence is written in a different place than the option (the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code), so the holder learns the order from the loss. Last intervention: the ordering itself: the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each costing nothing but the knowledge that an order exists. Tell: an option whose loss is triggered by an adjacent act rather than by time. Changed next move: before any first move on a matter, ask which objections must be in it, and take the objection before anything else. Not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock, since here inaction is the only thing that keeps it; not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date and the holder is the only one who can strike.

Rollback horizon. The way back to the old state closes at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read; the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes with no one deciding to close it. The migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects; the merger reversible until the first combined payroll; the new address reversible until the first piece of mail arrives there; the reorganization reversible until the first hire is made into the new chart; the currency changeover until the first contract is written in the new unit. Condition lost: a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, which the new state performs in the ordinary course of doing what it was built for, and which is not a decision about the reversal at all. Last intervention: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so that the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth. Tell: the new state's first ordinary output is the deadline, and no one will announce it. Changed next move: dual-write for a season, or accept that the first write ends the rollback. Adds to pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap: the moment at which one of them is lost. Adds to undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible: the reversal that stops being possible. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good, since here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine. An option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's. The patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the machine was keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed; the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening; the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection that a budget line can end; the interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider. Condition lost: a capability, the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Last intervention: a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible, each treating the bridge's start as the option's deadline. The ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified. Tell: the bridge's own start is the deadline; the situation has none of its own. Changed next move: on the day the bridge starts, start the far-shore process; a bridge started without it holds open nothing. Adds to lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour: the bridge that ends the option it holds open. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs, since here the clock is a harm no one signs.

Standstill with a term. A negotiated pause puts a date on a situation that had none, and the renewal belongs to the other side, who now knows exactly what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again; the negotiated leave of absence that dates a job which had no date and is extended only if the employer signs; the forbearance agreement that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days; the furlough whose recall rights run six months; the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. Condition lost: a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the situation that the holder wrote. Last intervention: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted; the Korean armistice is the exception that has no renewal date and is still called temporary. The statutory pauses (the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute, the restraining order's fourteen days) are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it; those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Tell: the holder signed the only dated paper in the matter, and the adversary read the price off the signature. Changed next move: ask for the renewal early, or file instead of tolling where filing alone would stop the clock. Adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip: the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.
